text:
anna_sales: Quick one 52 Acme wants an ephemeral hosted API key for a 14-day POC. They want: IP allowlist 18.205.0.0/16, auto-rotate every 48h, and automatic revoke at end of POC. Billing tag should be 'acct:acme-poc'. Can infra create and hand over a masked secret we can send to the customer?

diego_se: Console supports creating keys but for IP allowlist + auto-rotate + revoke on expiry we normally provision via infra so rotation jobs are wired up. Which email should be owner/contact for support escalation?

anna_sales: j.lee@acme.com is the contact. Single shared key for now. POC ends 2025-11-12.

tara_infra: I can spin it up under project sales-pocs. Confirming params: TTL=336h (14d), rotate=48h, ip=18.205.0.0/16, tags=[acct=acme-poc], owner=j.lee@acme.com, single key. Also will set approved-requesters list to include j.lee and will_cs so they can request emergency rotation.

opsbot: provisioning workflow started by tara_infra. Task ID: prov-8342.

tara_infra: Running internal command (no secret in chat):
```
rwdctl keys create --project sales-pocs --ttl 336h \\ 
  --ip-allowlist 18.205.0.0/16 --tags acct=acme-poc \\ 
  --rotate 48h --owner j.lee@acme.com --requesters j.lee@acme.com,will.cs@redwood.ai
```
Will produce a masked token in the vault and schedule rotations.

opsbot: key created (masked id rwd_key_abcd). Resource key-id: key-2841. Rotation scheduled every 48h. Expires in 14 days. Audit: created by tara_infra at 1933309939.

will_cs: I'll prepare an internal handoff note for Acme with the masked vault path and the support process: immediate revoke via `rwdctl keys revoke key-2841` and new key creation takes ~5-10 mins. Recommend they implement header fallback to avoid customer downtime during swap.

anna_sales: On the compromise question: Acme asked how we rotate quickly and keep sessions working. Any recommended playbook?

diego_se: Best practice: issue new key, update server to accept both keys for a short overlap window, then revoke the old key once clients have swapped. If they can't accept overlap, we revoke then issue new key and update clients. We can support either but overlap preferred to avoid 401s.

will_cs: Note for sales: hosted keys are bound to hosted runtime. If they later shift to Dedicated or Private, we need to create scoped credentials for that environment. Document in the handoff.

anna_sales: Perfect. Tara, can you paste the vault path and audit link (masked) here when it's ready?

tara_infra: Vault path: vault://projects/sales-pocs/keys/key-2841 (masked). Audit link: https://console.redwood.ai/audit/key-2841 (internal). Added a calendar reminder to revoke on POC end date 2025-11-12.

opsbot: Reminder task prov-8342 updated: revoke scheduled 2025-11-12.

anna_sales: Thanks team :pray: sending note to Acme now.
